content.short: MetaComp is a Singapore firm building AI and payment infrastructure across traditional and digital finance.
content.description: MetaComp builds infrastructure for hybrid finance that spans traditional and digital assets, including AI agents that understand transactions and assess risk inside financial systems, and stablecoin payment services. Stable's official ecosystem page lists MetaComp.
content.meta: MetaComp builds AI and stablecoin payment infrastructure for hybrid finance, listed on Stable.
